source_documents.title: Unique dual fluorescence emission in the solid state from a small molecule based on phenanthrocarbazole with an AIE luminogen as a single-molecule white-light emissive material

reference_evidence_units.quote: The blue emission band peaking at 446 and 477 nm
reference_evidence_units.subject: PCTrPE
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Solid thin film; Fig. 3 and Table 1.
reference_evidence_units.statement: PCTrPE has blue vibronic emission together with a broader approximately 507 nm band, producing white emission.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: The 509 nm single-band film result for PCTPE is a comparator and must not replace the PCTrPE spectrum.

reference_evidence_units.quote: with intra- and intermolecular energy transfer being totally restricted.
reference_evidence_units.subject: PCTrPE
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Interpretation of dual fluorescence in solid film and aggregate mixtures.
reference_evidence_units.statement: The source interprets the two components as contributions of weakly coupled molecular fluorophores rather than efficient transfer to a single low-energy emitter.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: The strong no-transfer wording is the authors' interpretation; it does not constitute measured zero transfer rate.

reference_evidence_units.quote: No delayed component can be observed
reference_evidence_units.subject: PCTrPE and PCTPE
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Transient PL in THF solutions and vacuum-deposited films; PCTrPE film lifetime reported as 3 ns.
reference_evidence_units.statement: No delayed component was detected; the source assigns the observed emission to prompt singlet decay.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Absence within the measurement window is not proof that no triplet population exists under any conditions.

reference_evidence_units.quote: PCTrPE in solutions with fw lower than 70%
reference_evidence_units.subject: PCTrPE
reference_evidence_units.statement: An additional long-wavelength band appears near 70% water; at 99% water broad white emission has a reported yield of 16%.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Emission wavelength and relative bands depend on morphology and medium; the two observed components are not evidence by themselves for anti-Kasha emission.

reference_evidence_units.quote: No obvious p–p interaction is observed in the crystal
reference_evidence_units.subject: PCTrPE crystal
reference_evidence_units.statement: Edge-to-face zigzag packing isolates PC planes and lacks obvious face-to-face pi stacking, which the source relates to reduced aggregation quenching.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Crystal packing is source-reported structural evidence, not confirmation of the inherited graph or proof that every film shares identical packing.

reference_evidence_units.quote: without any contribution from excimer and exciplex emission.
reference_evidence_units.subject: PCTrPE device
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Comparison of PL, EL and transport-layer spectra, Fig. 6.
reference_evidence_units.statement: The authors reject excimer/exciplex emission as the explanation for the white PCTrPE device emission.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: This bounded source interpretation must not be inverted into a positive excimer label merely because there is a red band.

reference_evidence_units.quote: XRD patterns of the drop-cast films
reference_evidence_units.subject: PCTrPE and PCTPE films
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Drop-cast film XRD continued on physical page 6.
reference_evidence_units.statement: The source identifies predominantly amorphous films, with packing context differing from the single-crystal analysis.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Do not silently treat single-crystal geometry as a measured atomistic structure of the amorphous films.

reference_mechanisms.label: PACKING_HOST_MATRIX_CONFINEMENT
reference_mechanisms.rationale: Geometry and packing differences underpin the source's comparison of dual emission and quenching in aggregated materials.

reference_mechanisms.label: RADIATIVE_RATE_STATE_BALANCE
reference_mechanisms.rationale: A provisional broad mapping of the two prompt emissive contributions and suppressed transfer; no specific radiative rate is inferred. Expert review should decide whether this dual-fluorophore explanation belongs in the existing state-balance family.
